--- title: "07 — fgsea: what's enriched among vent-associated KOs" subtitle: "Frenemies euk metaT — grain 4, vent vs. non-vent contrast, ranked by Cliff's delta on rCLR" author: "Hu Lab" date: last-modified format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 2 code-fold: show df-print: paged --- # Set up One ranked list, one fgsea call. Gene sets come from three families, each corrected for multiple testing within itself: the trophic-mode panel (each mode, and each subcategory, that holds enough ranked KOs), KEGG level-C pathways, and the Burns et al. 2018 families. Presence/absence of every panel gene across L4 taxa is in 06; fgsea is the set-level test for the panel sets large enough to support one, and the last section places every panel KO on this ranking for context. >SKH: 2026-11-08 (later), trophic-mode panel sets tested again as their own BH family, with a stricter floor (`PANEL_MIN_SET_SIZE` = 15 ranked KOs, the GSEA default; Subramanian et al. 2005 PNAS 102:15545). Smaller panel sets stay descriptive (06 and the last section). >SKH: 2026-11-08, curated heterotrophy subcategory and KEGG-pathway sets removed from the test (external sets only). Backup: `scripts/_to_delete/pre_panel_redesign_20261108/`. >SKH: streamlined 2026-11-07. Span classes and the carrier control were removed with the rest of the span work in 05b/06. The universe now comes from the 05 habitat classes. Backup: `scripts/_to_delete/pre_streamline_20261107/`. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # locator: root (render) or scripts/ (interactive) source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R") ``` ::: ## Assign parameters Same vent scope and grain as 04/05, so the ranked list and the habitat classes describe the same feature space. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} FIELDS_IN_SCOPE <- c("Gorda Ridge", "Von Damm", "Piccard") CHOSEN_DEPTH <- 4 # grain locked in 02 MIN_SET_SIZE <- 5 # gene sets below this are dropped before fgsea; below the # usual 15, so sets with < 10 ranked KOs are flagged small_set # >SKH: trophic-mode panel sets need >= 15 ranked KOs to be tested (2026-11-08) PANEL_MIN_SET_SIZE <- 15 PANEL_TABLE <- "data/gene-lists/trophic_mode_panel.csv" # scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R HABITAT_TABLE <- "output-tables/05_ko_habitat_class.csv" # from 05 (habitat class per KO) VENT_ASSOCIATED <- c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared") # detected in >= 30% of vent units # >SKH: panel features with their 06 habitat class, placed on the ranking at the end # (descriptive, not tested; 2026-11-08) PANEL_HABITAT <- "output-tables/06_panel_habitat.csv" # >SKH: KEGG level-C pathways (four Cellular/Environmental categories) and the Burns et al. # 2018 trophic-mode families, compiled by scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R (2026-10-22) TROPHIC_SETS <- "data/gene-lists/trophic_gene_sets.csv" ``` ::: # Ranked list: vent vs. non-vent contrast for each vent-associated KO Ranking statistic = **Cliff's delta between vent and non-vent sample units** for each KO's robust-CLR values (`contrast_ranks()`, `R/cliffs_delta.R`). Positive delta means that KO ranks higher at vents; the magnitude is the net share of vent/non-vent unit pairs agreeing on the direction (Cliff 1993, Psychol Bull 114:494-509; Vargha and Delaney 2000, J Educ Behav Stat 25:101-132). **This reverses the note that a vent-vs-non-vent contrast must not enter through fgsea** (that note dated 2026-09-25; reversed 2026-09-27). The reason the differential was dropped is specific to the *KO-level* test: with 13 vent and 6 non-vent units, no permutation p reaches BH significance and the differential set empties. fgsea never tests a KO on its own, it asks whether a whole gene set sits toward one end of the ranked list, which is the case GSEA was built for (Subramanian et al. 2005, PNAS 102:15545-15550). The set-level result is a different test at a different resolution, not a re-entry of the dropped one, and it does not depend on any single KO clearing the 95th-percentile permutation threshold. Keep saying *relative*: this is compositional. The universe is the vent-associated KO set (detected in >= 30% of vent units, i.e. >= 4 of 13, under the shared detection rule), read from the 05 habitat classes (`vent_only`, `vent_skewed` and `shared`) rather than recomputed. Units on **both** sides of the contrast come from the full paired table (vent + non-vent), since a vent-only matrix cannot express the contrast. >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # built once at the end of 02 (R/load_paired.R) paired_all <- load_paired(fields = FIELDS_IN_SCOPE, depth = CHOSEN_DEPTH) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` [load_paired] data/processed/paired_L4.RData (built 2026-11-08 11:40; 324,868 rows) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ko_habitat <- build_matrix(paired_all, "ko_id", min_tpm = 0, transform = params$transform, id_col = "sample_id", aggregate = "mean", unit_col = "sample_unit") # $z is the transformed matrix $dist was built from; $mat is RAW abundance. # (build_matrix() gained $z on 2026-09-27, after a ranking built here from $mat # turned out to be raw mean scaledTPM mislabelled as mean CLR.) ko_habitat_z <- ko_habitat$z habitat_by_unit <- paired_all |> distinct(sample_unit, vent_bin) |> deframe() unit_is_vent <- habitat_by_unit[rownames(ko_habitat_z)] == "Vent" stopifnot(setequal(rownames(ko_habitat_z), names(habitat_by_unit)), any(unit_is_vent), !all(unit_is_vent)) message(glue("{sum(unit_is_vent)} vent units vs {sum(!unit_is_vent)} non-vent units | ", "{ncol(ko_habitat_z)} KOs in the paired matrix")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 13 vent units vs 6 non-vent units | 7690 KOs in the paired matrix ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ko_habitat_delta <- tibble( ko_id = colnames(ko_habitat_z), delta_vent = contrast_ranks(ko_habitat_z, habitat_by_unit, focal = "Vent") ) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ko_universe <- read_csv(HABITAT_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(habitat_class %in% VENT_ASSOCIATED) |> select(ko_id, habitat_class) ranks_df <- ko_habitat_delta |> inner_join(ko_universe, by = "ko_id") |> filter(is.finite(delta_vent)) |> arrange(desc(delta_vent)) message(glue("{nrow(ranks_df)} vent-associated KOs ranked ", "({nrow(ko_universe) - nrow(ranks_df)} dropped: absent from ", "the paired matrix, or non-finite delta)")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 866 vent-associated KOs ranked (0 dropped: absent from the paired matrix, or non-finite delta) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ranks <- ranks_df |> select(ko_id, delta_vent) |> deframe() ``` ::: ## Sign check A positive delta has to mean higher at vents. Check it against the CLR means of the two extreme KOs rather than trusting the convention, since an inverted sign would flip every NES in the table with no other symptom. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} sign_check <- ranks_df |> slice(c(1, n())) |> mutate(mean_clr_vent = map_dbl(ko_id, \(k) mean(ko_habitat_z[unit_is_vent, k])), mean_clr_nonvent = map_dbl(ko_id, \(k) mean(ko_habitat_z[!unit_is_vent, k])), agrees = sign(delta_vent) == sign(mean_clr_vent - mean_clr_nonvent)) sign_check ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} stopifnot(all(sign_check$agrees)) ``` ::: # Gene sets ## Trophic-mode panel sets >SKH: 2026-11-08. Sets come from `data/gene-lists/trophic_mode_panel.csv` at two levels: each trophic mode (all its KOs) and each subcategory within a mode. Only KO-matched features enter; Pfam-matched genes have no place on a KO ranking. A set is tested only if ≥ `PANEL_MIN_SET_SIZE` (15) of its KOs are in the ranked (vent-associated) universe, the GSEA default minimum (Subramanian et al. 2005). Mode sets contain their subcategory sets, so results within this family are nested, not independent. Every candidate set and its ranked size is written to `07_fgsea_panel_set_sizes.csv`, so the untested ones are on record. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} panel_ko <- read_csv(PANEL_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(match_type == "ko", !is.na(subcategory)) |> distinct(category, subcategory, ko_id) panel_candidates <- bind_rows( panel_ko |> distinct(category, ko_id) |> mutate(level = "mode", set_name = glue("Panel mode: {category}")), panel_ko |> mutate(level = "subcategory", set_name = glue("Panel: {category} / {subcategory}")) ) |> distinct(level, category, set_name, ko_id) panel_set_sizes <- panel_candidates |> summarise(n_ko = n_distinct(ko_id), n_ranked = sum(unique(ko_id) %in% names(ranks)), .by = c(level, category, set_name)) |> mutate(tested = n_ranked >= PANEL_MIN_SET_SIZE) |> arrange(category, level, desc(n_ranked)) panel_set_sizes ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} panel_sets <- panel_candidates |> filter(set_name %in% panel_set_sizes$set_name[panel_set_sizes$tested]) |> (\(d) split(d$ko_id, as.character(d$set_name)))() message(glue("{length(panel_sets)} of {nrow(panel_set_sizes)} panel sets have >= ", "{PANEL_MIN_SET_SIZE} ranked KOs and are tested")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 2 of 33 panel sets have >= 15 ranked KOs and are tested ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} write_csv(panel_set_sizes, "output-tables/07_fgsea_panel_set_sizes.csv") ``` ::: ## Habitat classes are not tested The 05 habitat classes (vent-only, vent-skewed, shared) are **not** tested as gene sets here: they are defined by non-vent occupancy, so their position on a vent-vs-non-vent ranking is built in. ## KEGG level-C pathways and Burns et al. 2018 trophic-mode families Two outside sources, so the result does not depend on hand-picked membership (2026-10-21: approaches A and B). * `kegg_level_c`: the KEGG pathway maps in Transport and catabolism, Signal transduction, Cell growth and death and Cell motility kept for protists in `data/gene-lists/kegg_levelC_curation.csv`, with full KEGG membership. The two-component system map is kept on purpose (hybrid histidine kinases occur in some eukaryotes; SKH 2026-10-25), and the yeast and animal variants of generic maps are kept by scope. Many maps share the same kinase core, and the yeast variants largely repeat their generic maps, so these sets overlap; read them as one family, not as independent results. * `burns2018`: protein families whose presence predicts phagocytosis, photosynthesis or prototrophy across 35 eukaryotic genomes (Burns et al. 2018, *Nat Ecol Evol* 2:697–704), mapped from UniProt representatives to KOs in 00b. Those families were chosen to predict *gene content*; here they are tested for a *shift in expression* between habitats, which is a different question from the one they were built for. The protist experimental set (00b) is too small to clear `MIN_SET_SIZE` in this universe; 06 reports it KO by KO instead. >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} trophic_ref <- read_csv(TROPHIC_SETS, show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(set_source %in% c("kegg_level_c", "burns2018")) trophic_sets_by_source <- trophic_ref |> distinct(set_source, set_name, ko_id) |> (\(d) split(d, d$set_source))() |> map(\(d) split(d$ko_id, d$set_name)) kegg_level_c_sets <- trophic_sets_by_source$kegg_level_c %||% list() burns_sets <- trophic_sets_by_source$burns2018 %||% list() if (!length(burns_sets)) { message("No burns2018 sets in ", TROPHIC_SETS, ": run scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R ", "once with a network connection to build the UniProt -> KO cache.") } tibble(pathway = c(names(kegg_level_c_sets), names(burns_sets)), source = rep(c("kegg_level_c", "burns2018"), c(length(kegg_level_c_sets), length(burns_sets))), n = c(lengths(kegg_level_c_sets), lengths(burns_sets)), n_ranked = map_int(c(kegg_level_c_sets, burns_sets), \(k) sum(k %in% names(ranks)))) |> arrange(source, desc(n_ranked)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Combine, tag by source Size filtering happens on membership **inside the ranked universe**, not on raw membership. `fgsea()`'s own `minSize` applies to each set after intersecting it with `stats`, so a set with >= `MIN_SET_SIZE` KOs overall but fewer than that among the ranked KOs used to clear the filter here and then get dropped silently by `fgsea()`, which is what broke `nrow(enrich) == length(all_sets)` in the QC block (diagnosed and fixed 2026-09-27). **Multiple testing by family** (>SKH: 2026-10-22; panel family re-added 2026-11-08). BH is applied within each source: `trophic_mode_panel`, `kegg_level_c` and `burns2018` are one family each. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} all_sets <- c(panel_sets, kegg_level_c_sets, burns_sets) set_source <- rep(c("trophic_mode_panel", "kegg_level_c", "burns2018"), c(length(panel_sets), length(kegg_level_c_sets), length(burns_sets))) names(set_source) <- names(all_sets) # >SKH: BH family per source (see above) set_family <- c(trophic_mode_panel = "trophic_mode_panel", kegg_level_c = "kegg_level_c", burns2018 = "burns2018") # de-duplicate names across sources before filtering by size (fgsea keys on name) names(all_sets) <- make.unique(names(all_sets)) names(set_source) <- names(all_sets) size_in_universe <- lengths(map(all_sets, intersect, names(ranks))) n_dropped <- sum(size_in_universe < MIN_SET_SIZE) all_sets <- all_sets[size_in_universe >= MIN_SET_SIZE] set_source <- set_source[names(all_sets)] message(glue("{length(all_sets)} gene sets kept | {n_dropped} dropped: fewer than ", "{MIN_SET_SIZE} members among the {length(ranks)} ranked KOs")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 31 gene sets kept | 7 dropped: fewer than 5 members among the 866 ranked KOs ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} tibble(source = set_source) |> count(source, name = "n_sets_kept") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: # fgsea Set-level enrichment (GSEA), not a per-KO differential expression test. `fgsea()` takes the gene sets (`all_sets`) and the ranked statistic (`ranks`, Cliff's delta vent vs. non-vent) and asks whether each set sits toward one end of the ranked list. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # BiocManager::install("fgsea") library(fgsea) set.seed(params$seed) # ?fgsea() enrich <- fgsea(pathways = all_sets, stats = ranks, minSize = MIN_SET_SIZE, eps = 0) |> as_tibble() |> mutate(source = set_source[pathway], family = unname(set_family[source])) |> relocate(source, family, .after = pathway) |> # >SKH: fgsea's padj is BH across every set passed in; recompute it within family mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"), .by = family) |> # A 5-KO set gives an unstable NES and a 2-3 gene leading edge. Flagged rather # than dropped, so set size travels with every claim (2026-09-27). mutate(small_set = size < 10) |> arrange(padj) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning in prepareStats(stats, scoreType, gseaParam): There are ties in the preranked stats (58.89% of the list). The order of those tied genes will be arbitrary, which may produce unexpected results. ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} enrich |> select(pathway, source, family, size, small_set, NES, pval, padj) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: * Pathway: tested gene set we looked at * source: where did gene set come from. * size: number of KOs in the gene set after filtering the ranked list * NES: normalized enrichment score. neg vs. pos is the direction of the enrichment (i.e., when positive it means they are positively enriched) and the magnitude is the strenth relative to the gene-set size * pval: permutation p-value * padj: BH-adjusted p-value With the vent-vs-non-vent ranking, a positive NES means the set sits toward the vent-skewed (high-delta) end of the ranked list; negative means the non-vent-skewed end. *source*: _trophic_mode_panel_ (sets with ≥ 15 ranked KOs), _kegg_level_c_ and _burns2018_ (one BH family each). _small_set_ flags sets holding fewer than 10 KOs of the ranked universe. `MIN_SET_SIZE` is 5, below the usual GSEA floor of 10-15, so report size alongside any claim from a flagged set. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} write_csv(enrich |> select(-leadingEdge), "output-tables/07_fgsea_all_sets.csv") # leadingEdge is list-column (KO ids driving each set's ES); saved separately for lookups enrich |> select(pathway, source) |> mutate(leading_edge = map_chr(enrich$leadingEdge, \(x) paste(x, collapse = " | "))) |> write_csv("output-tables/07_fgsea_leading_edge.csv") ``` ::: # Sensitivity: order of tied ranks Cliff's delta between 13 vent and 6 non-vent units can only take values in steps of 1/78 (157 possible values), so many of the ranked KOs share a value and `fgsea()` warns that the order of tied KOs is arbitrary. Enrichment scores depend on that order. This check re-runs fgsea `N_TIE_DRAWS` times, each time adding jitter smaller than one third of the smallest gap between distinct values: the order **within** ties changes, the order **between** distinct values never does. A set whose NES sign and BH call hold across draws does not depend on tie order. >SKH: assistant-added (2026-10-14). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} N_TIE_DRAWS <- 100 tie_draws <- function(stats, sets, n_draws = N_TIE_DRAWS) { gap <- min(diff(sort(unique(stats)))) if (!is.finite(gap)) gap <- 1e-6 purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(n_draws), \(i) { jittered <- stats + stats::runif(length(stats), -gap / 3, gap / 3) fgsea(pathways = sets, stats = jittered, minSize = MIN_SET_SIZE, eps = 0) |> as_tibble() |> # >SKH: same within-family BH as the main run mutate(family = unname(set_family[set_source[pathway]])) |> mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"), .by = family) |> select(pathway, NES, padj) |> mutate(draw = i) }) } summarise_ties <- function(draws) { draws |> summarise(NES_median = median(NES, na.rm = TRUE), NES_min = min(NES, na.rm = TRUE), NES_max = max(NES, na.rm = TRUE), padj_median = median(padj, na.rm = TRUE), padj_max = max(padj, na.rm = TRUE), frac_sig = mean(padj <= params$fdr_alpha, na.rm = TRUE), sign_stable = all(sign(NES) == sign(median(NES, na.rm = TRUE)), na.rm = TRUE), .by = pathway) } message(glue("Tied values: {round(100 * mean(duplicated(ranks) | duplicated(ranks, fromLast = TRUE)), 1)}% ", "of the ranking")) set.seed(params$seed) tie_sensitivity <- tie_draws(ranks, all_sets) |> summarise_ties() |> left_join(enrich |> select(pathway, source, size, NES, padj), by = "pathway") |> mutate(ranking = "vent vs. non-vent delta", .before = 1) |> arrange(padj) tie_sensitivity |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) signif(x, 3))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} write_csv(tie_sensitivity, "output-tables/07_fgsea_tie_sensitivity.csv") ``` ::: > For results: for any set you report, the NES range and `frac_sig` across tie orders from `07_fgsea_tie_sensitivity.csv`. A set with `frac_sig` near 1 and `sign_stable` TRUE does not depend on how ties were ordered. # Panel features on the ranking (descriptive, not tested) Each KO-matched panel feature from 06, with its Cliff's delta (vent vs. non-vent, the statistic ranked above) and its 06 habitat class. The delta is shown for every panel KO in the paired matrix, not only the vent-associated universe that fgsea ranks; `in_ranked_universe` marks which ones fgsea saw. Pfam-matched features have no KO column in the matrix and are left out. rCLR leaves zeros at 0, so a KO absent from a unit sits at that unit's average, which pulls deltas of sparse KOs toward zero. >SKH: added 2026-11-08. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} panel_habitat <- read_csv(PANEL_HABITAT, show_col_types = FALSE) panel_delta <- panel_habitat |> filter(match_type == "ko") |> select(feature_id, category, subcategory, gene, habitat_class, n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent) |> left_join(ko_habitat_delta, by = c("feature_id" = "ko_id")) |> mutate(in_ranked_universe = feature_id %in% names(ranks), habitat_class = factor(habitat_class, levels = c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared", "nonvent_skewed", "nonvent_only", "below_filter", "not_detected"))) message(glue("{sum(!is.na(panel_delta$delta_vent))} of {nrow(panel_delta)} panel KOs have a delta | ", "{sum(panel_delta$in_ranked_universe)} are in the ranked universe")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 232 of 255 panel KOs have a delta | 97 are in the ranked universe ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} panel_delta |> filter(!is.na(delta_vent)) |> summarise(n = n(), median_delta = median(delta_vent), n_higher_vent = sum(delta_vent > 0), .by = category) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} write_csv(panel_delta, "output-tables/07_panel_ko_delta.csv") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} class_pal <- c(vent_only = "#b74a70", vent_skewed = "#dba3b8", shared = "grey45", nonvent_skewed = "#9cc2c2", nonvent_only = "#346D6E", below_filter = "grey85", not_detected = "white") fig_panel_ranking <- panel_delta |> filter(!is.na(delta_vent)) |> # regex kept outside glue(): glue re-parses its {} text, which turns "\\(" into an invalid "\(" mutate(gene_short = str_remove(gene, " \\(.*$"), label = fct_reorder(glue("{gene_short} ({feature_id})"), delta_vent), mode = str_wrap(category, 12)) |> ggplot(aes(delta_vent, label, fill = habitat_class, shape = in_ranked_universe)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") + geom_point(size = 2, colour = "grey20") + scale_fill_manual(values = class_pal, name = "06 habitat class", drop = FALSE) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 21, `FALSE` = 22), labels = c(`TRUE` = "In ranked universe", `FALSE` = "Not ranked"), name = NULL) + guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + facet_grid(mode ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + labs(x = "Cliff's delta on rCLR (positive = higher at vents)", y = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 7) + theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0)) fig_panel_ranking # ggsave("figures/07-panel-on-ranking.svg", fig_panel_ranking, width = 8, height = 18) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07-fgsea-enrichment_files/figure-html/fig-panel-on-ranking-1.png){#fig-panel-on-ranking width=768} ::: ::: > Supplemental: panel KOs on the vent/non-vent ranking (`07_panel_ko_delta.csv`). > Descriptive, per KO;
